extracted.intended_audience: general audience; people seeking to improve skills or performance (professionals, learners, coaches)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on how coaching improves performance: what a good coach does (gives accurate feedback, builds habits, breaks skills into parts) and why coaching matters for future growth. Applies to individuals aiming to get better at complex skills.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coach provides a more accurate picture of reality
rubrics_metrics.description: A good coach gives an external, more accurate picture of our reality—helping us see what we actually do and where we fall short.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coaches offer honest, external feedback to reveal blind spots and correct self-misperceptions; this clarity is a foundation for targeted improvement. (From: 'provide a more accurate picture of our reality.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Coach instills positive habits of thinking
rubrics_metrics.description: Coaches help instill constructive mental habits and ways of thinking that support ongoing improvement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond one-off advice, coaching shapes thought patterns and approaches to problems so that individuals adopt habits that improve decision-making and performance over time. (From: 'to instill positive habits of thinking.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Coach breaks actions down and helps rebuild skills
rubrics_metrics.description: A coach decomposes complex actions into component parts and then guides rebuilding and practice of those parts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coaching involves analyzing tasks, isolating sub-skills, and providing stepwise instruction and practice to assemble stronger overall performance. (From: 'to break our actions down and then help us build them back up again.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on future improvement (trajectory over current level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective coaching focuses on how good you are going to become, not just how good you are now.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The measure of coaching success is improvement trajectory and potential; coaches orient learners toward continuous growth rather than static assessment. (From quote: 'It's not how good you are now; it's how good you're going to be that really matters.')

rubrics_metrics.name: Use coaching to improve in the face of complexity
rubrics_metrics.description: Coaching is the key strategy for improving performance when tasks or contexts are complex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When facing complex challenges, structured coaching provides the outside perspective, habit-building, and task decomposition needed to make meaningful progress. (From: 'How do we improve in the face of complexity? ... having a good coach...')
